where: Section 1, binomial array factor, and Quiz Q2 answer
problem: The exponent is lost in the binomial array factor. Written as |cos(ψ/2)|N−1 it reads as |cos(ψ/2)| multiplied by (N−1), which is a different function and is not the binomial pattern.
fix: Write it as |cos(ψ/2)|<sup>N−1</sup> (the array factor of an N-element binomial array, with ψ = βd sinθ when α = 0).

where: Exam traps, fourth trap (sidelobe dB and R)
problem: The formula "R = 10−SLLdB/20" has lost its exponent and reads as 10 minus SLLdB/20. A student following it literally gets R = 11 for a −20 dB sidelobe instead of R = 10.
fix: Write R = 10<sup>−SLL<sub>dB</sub>/20</sup>, so a −20 dB sidelobe gives R = 10<sup>20/20</sup> = 10.

problem: The answer stays qualitative and never puts a number on the squint, so the student cannot check the calculation.
fix: Add the numbers: sinθ₀ = sin 40° × (10/12) = 0.643 × 0.833 = 0.536, so θ₀ ≈ 32.4° at 12 GHz, still towards broadside.
